name: Python 3
updateContentCommand: [ -f packages.txt ] && sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y && sudo xargs apt install -y <packages.txt; python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip; [ -f requirements.txt ] && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt; .venv/bin/pip install streamlit; echo '✅ Packages installed and Requirements met'
postStartCommand: if [ ! -d .venv ]; then python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/pip install streamlit; fi
